FITB is now deploying its product line, including a more robust mortgage platform, treasury management, and capital markets capabilities, across Comerica's legacy commercial clients. "With strong customer retention rates, the pro forma franchise is set for sustained revenue growth as these new products gain traction," Citi analyst Benjamin Gerlinger wrote in a note to clients.

The bank is also well-positioned in the current rate environment, as the addition of Comerica's commercial-heavy loan book boosts Fifth Third's (FITG) asset sensitivity. "A large portion of the variable-rate loan portfolio is positioned for positive repricing, supporting further NIM (net interest margin) expansion," Gerlinger said. "This enhanced margin profile, combined with disciplined expense management and a strong credit environment, underpins the bank's durable earnings power."
